mapper.select:
select * from ( select lr.ID, lr.STEEL_RING_CODE, lr.MACHINE_CODE, lr.LOSS_RATE, lr.IS_DELETE, lr.CREATE_BY, lr.CREATE_TIME, lr.UPDATE_BY, lr.UPDATE_TIME, lr.REMARK, mi.MACHINE_NAME from T_GSQ_LOSS_SETTING lr left join T_GSQ_MACHINE_INFO mi on lr.MACHINE_CODE = mi.MACHINE_CODE and mi.IS_DELETE = '0' where lr.IS_DELETE = '0'
and lr.STEEL_RING_CODE like concat('%', #{steelRingCode}, '%')
and lr.MACHINE_CODE = #{machineCode}
order by lr.CREATE_TIME desc ) t
